cost: Search/insert/remove O(height); height<=n<=4096 but may be n. Expected O(log n) requires independently random priorities, not explicit arbitrary inputs. Keys O(n) traversal and output; arena O(maximum live count) with slot reuse.
forward: Search by unique i64 key. New insertion attaches a leaf and rotates it upward while its (priority,key) is less than parent's. Deletion rotates the target downward with the smaller-ranked child until it is a leaf, detaches it and recycles the arena slot. Return membership booleans and sorted keys.
inverse: Typed behavior complement, ambiguous reverse reconstruction and specializations in model.md
limitations: Exact bounded APIs only. No generic 1/2/5/10% accuracy surrogate is supported. Finite tests do not prove universal correctness or runtime gains. Standard Vec/Box/BTreeMap allocation failure may abort or panic; allocator refusal is not injected. No callbacks, I/O or concurrency effects.
